{{Infobox football league season | image = 2006 Chinese Super League.jpg | competition = [[Chinese Super League]] | season = 2006 | winners = [[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Shandong Luneng]] | relegated = [[Chongqing Liangjiang Athletic F.C.|Chongqing Lifan]] | continentalcup1 = [[2007 AFC Champions League|AFC Champions League]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers = {{ubl|[[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Shandong Luneng]] | [[Shanghai Shenhua F.C.|Shanghai Shenhua]]}} | continentalcup2 = [[2007 A3 Champions Cup|A3 Champions Cup]] | continentalcup2 qualifiers = {{ubl|[[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Shandong Luneng]] | [[Shanghai Shenhua F.C.|Shanghai Shenhua]]}} | league topscorer = [[Li Jinyu]] (26 goals) | matches = 210 | total goals = 496 | average attendance = 10,611 | prevseason = [[2005 Chinese Super League|2005]] | nextseason = [[2007 Chinese Super League|2007]] }} The '''2006 Chinese Super League''' was the third season since the establishment of the Chinese Football Association Super League (中国足球协会超级联赛 or 中超), also known as [[Chinese Super League]], the thirteenth season of professional association football league and the 45th top-tier league season in China. The premier [[association football|football]] league in [[China]] under the auspices of the [[Chinese Football Association]], the season started on March 11, 2006 and ended on October 22. Initially, it was planned that there would be two teams relegated at the end of the season, however this was changed to one when [[Sichuan First City F.C.|Sichuan First City]] folded before the start of the season. ==Promotion and relegation== '''Teams promoted from [[2005 China League One]]''' *[[Xiamen Blue Lions F.C.|Xiamen Lanshi]] *[[Changchun Yatai F.C.|Changchun Yatai]] '''Teams relegated after end of [[2005 Chinese Super League]]''' *None ==Overview== ===Preseason=== A number of changes occurred during the off season, notably some major changes to the teams. Inter Shanghai moved to [[Xi'an]] and was renamed [[Beijing Chengfeng F.C.|Xi'an Chanba]]. Shanghai Zobon was renamed [[Shanghai United F.C.|Shanghai United]]. Beijing Hyundai, who did not renew their contract with [[Hyundai Motor Company|Hyundai]], changed their team name back to their formal name, [[Beijing Guoan F.C.|Beijing Guoan]]. Shenzhen Jianlibao changed its team name to [[Shenzhen F.C.|Shenzhen Kingway]] after finding a new sponsor in [[Kingway Brewery]]. There was also some speculation that [[Liaoning F.C.|Liaoning]] would pull out from the league, and that the Chinese Football Association had prepared a schedule with only 14 teams should Liaoning have withdrawn. The biggest shock was the disbanding of [[Sichuan First City F.C.|Sichuan First City]] in January, so the league will only have 15 teams at the start of the season, one short of the 16 teams planned. ===Player transfers=== [[Shanghai Shenhua F.C.|Shanghai Shenhua]], who qualified for the [[AFC Champions League Elite|AFC Champions League]], boost their squad with [[Li Weifeng]] from the debt-ridden Shenzhen Jianlibao for 6.5 million RMB, the highest transfer fee a club has ever received that season. In addition, Shenhua bought over [[Liu Yunfei]] from [[Tianjin Jinmen Tiger F.C.|Tianjin TEDA]] for 0.9 million and recalled defender [[Du Wei (footballer)|Du Wei]] from [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]]. Desperately in need of money, Shenzhen was also forced to sell China's first choice goalkeeper, [[Li Leilei]] to [[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Shandong Luneng]] for 5 million, former national striker [[Yang Chen (footballer, born 1974)|Yang Chen]] to the newly promoted [[Xiamen Blue Lions F.C.|Xiamen Lanshi]] for 2 million and [[Zhou Ting]] to Beijing Guoan for 3.5 million. Other notable transfers included [[Wang Liang (footballer, born 1979)|Wang Liang]]'s 5 million move from Liaoning to Shandong, [[An Qi]]'s 4 million move from defending champions [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Shide]] to Xiamen, and four players from Shandong ([[An Shuai]], [[Zhou Yi (footballer)|Zhou Yi]], [[Sun Bing]], and [[Cha Kejun]]) to [[Qingdao Hainiu F.C.|Qingdao Jonoon]] for 1 million each. ===The season=== Shandong Luneng and newcomer [[Changchun Yatai F.C.|Changchun Yatai]] both had a good spell early on while defending champions Dalian Shide struggled early on. During the mid season, Changchun finally cannot kept up with the pace of the top league and gradually drops to fourth in the league. Meanwhile, a record 13 league win in a row saw Shandong gaining an unassailable lead at the top. With Shandong the clear winner, the interest in the second half of the season was the race to the second place and the fight against relegation. In the end, [[Chongqing Liangjiang Athletic F.C.|Chongqing Lifan]] were relegated with two games to go while the race for second went all the way down to the wire before Shanghai Shenhua clinch the second spot with a last day win over Liaoning while Beijing Guoan slips. ==Personnel== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:95%" |- !Team !Manager |- | [[Beijing Guoan F.C.|Beijing Guoan]] | {{flagicon|China}} [[Shen Xiangfu]] |- | [[Changchun Yatai F.C.|Changchun Yatai]] | {{flagicon|Netherlands}} [[Arie Schans]] |- | [[Chongqing Liangjiang Athletic F.C.|Chongqing Lifan]] | {{flagicon|Croatia}} [[Stjepan Čordaš]] |- | [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Shide]] | {{flagicon|Serbia and Montenegro}} [[Vladimir Petrović]] |- | [[Liaoning F.C.|Liaoning]] | {{flagicon|China}} [[Tang Yaodong]] |- | [[Qingdao Hainiu F.C.|Qingdao Jonoon]] | {{flagicon|China}} [[Yin Tiesheng]] |- | [[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Shandong Luneng]] | {{flagicon|Serbia and Montenegro}} [[Ljubiša Tumbaković]] |- | [[Shanghai Shenhua F.C.|Shanghai Shenhua]] | {{flagicon|China}} [[Wu Jingui]] |- | [[Shanghai Zobon F.C.|Shanghai United]] | {{flagicon|Uruguay}} [[Osvaldo Giménez]] |- | [[Guangzhou City F.C.|Shenyang Ginde]] | {{flagicon|Netherlands}} [[Martin Koopman]] |- | [[Shenzhen F.C.|Shenzhen Kingway]] | {{flagicon|China}} [[Xie Feng (footballer)|Xie Feng]] |- | [[Tianjin Jinmen Tiger F.C.|Tianjin TEDA]] | {{flagicon|China}} [[Liu Chunming]] |- | [[Wuhan Optics Valley F.C.|Wuhan Optics Valley]] | {{flagicon|China}} [[Pei Encai]] |- | [[Beijing Chengfeng F.C.|Xi'an Chanba]] | {{flagicon|China}} [[Cheng Yaodong]] |- | [[Xiamen Blue Lions F.C.|Xiamen Lanshi]] | {{flagicon|China}} [[Gao Hongbo]] |} ==Foreign players== The number of foreign players is restricted to three, but all teams can only use two foreign players on the field in each game.
